description: Per-sample multiclass Dice loss with inverse-squared target class volumes, following the GDL_v weighting in paper §2.1, Eq. (GDL). The loss applies no smoothing and requires every class to appear in every sample.

examples.title: Train a multiclass segmenter with Generalised Dice Loss

name: Generalised Dice Loss (GDL_v)

parameters.additional parameters: none; unknown keyword arguments raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because the dense one-hot target formula has no ignored-label rule
parameters.logits_or_prediction: finite floating-point class probabilities in [0, 1] shaped [B, K, *spatial], with K >= 2
parameters.reduction: none returns one loss per sample, mean averages samples, or sum adds samples (default mean)
parameters.targets: dense one-hot class masks matching [B, K, *spatial], with positive target volume for every class in every sample
